sections.label: Support for MTL preschool teachers
sections.summary: The Government supports locals to become Mother Tongue Language preschool teachers through specialised tracks, training awards, mid-career programmes and an annual award.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Of the early childhood educators who specialise in teaching MTLs, about 60% are locals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Government has been working to encourage and support more locals to become MTL preschool teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: From 2016, polytechnic students who wish to become MTL preschool teachers can pursue specialised MTL tracks in Early Childhood.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) also supports these students with training awards, such as course fee sponsorship, allowance grants and professional development grants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To encourage mid-career entrants to join the sector, ECDA, Skills Future Singapore and Workforce Singapore also provide support for them to enrol in English or MTL Early Childhood diplomas offered by a range of training providers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The support is available in the form of course fee subsidies, in-training allowances and salary grants under the Professional Conversion Programme and other place-and-train modes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) annually presents the Outstanding Preschool MTL Teacher Award to raise the profile of MTL preschool teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Going forward, ECDA will work closely with the new National Institute for Early Childhood Development and other sector partners to enhance the training and career development of MTL teachers and encourage more locals to take up MTL teaching in preschools.
